attchmntText: Jindal Drilling And Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Jindal Drilling and Industries Limited approved un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The Board meeting was held on 13 November 2026. Standalone net income from operations was Rs. 28,595 lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 56,133 lakhs for the half year. Standalone profit before tax was Rs. 9,801 lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 16,870 lakhs for the half year. Standalone profit for the period was Rs. 7,538 lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 12,779 lakhs for the half year. Basic earnings per share were Rs. 26.01 for the quarter and Rs. 44.10 for the half year. Consolidated net income from operations was Rs. 28,595 lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 56,133 lakhs for the half year. Consolidated profit before tax was Rs. 8,848 lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 15,390 lakhs for the half year. Consolidated profit for the period was Rs. 6,585 lakhs for the quarter and Rs. 11,299 lakhs for the half year. Basic earnings per share were Rs. 22.72 for the quarter and Rs. 38.99 for the half year. Limited review reports were issued by Kanodia Sanyal and Associates.

attchmntText: Jindal Drilling And Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Jindal Drilling and Industries Limited has announced an earnings call for the second quarter of the fiscal year twenty twenty seven. The management will meet investors on the sixteenth of November twenty twenty six. The event is organized by Emkay Global Financial Services Limited. It will be held as a virtual meeting or conference call. The scheduled time is twelve noon Indian Standard Time. Participants can join via a provided registration link or dial-in numbers. Kaushal Bengani from Jindal Drilling and Industries Ltd will participate in the discussion. This notice is issued pursuant to Regulation thirty of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations twenty fifteen.
